nom: COSRX One Step Original Peptide Collagen Lifting Glow Pad

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination/oily-prone chin skin reports no issue using it alongside dealing with acne there.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or very dry skin report strong hydration, plumping, and no dry patches through the day, with one dry-skin user also noting smoothed smile lines.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report even, visible hydration and no problem with excess oil or breakouts.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report no stinging, irritation, or adverse reaction and some redness improvement, but one sensitive-skin reviewer describes new breakouts and another found the residue too tacky.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (including several self-described as older or 'a certain age') report increased firmness, plumpness, and reduced look of fine lines with continued use.
segments.normal: No reviews specifically identify normal skin as a distinct category.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers pursuing anti-aging effects report firmer, plumper skin and reduced appearance of fine lines/smile lines after days to weeks of use; a few say they notice no lifting or wrinkle change yet, attributing it to short use time.
concerns.dehydration: Overwhelmingly reviewers report immediate and lasting hydration, plumpness, and no dry patches, making this the most consistently confirmed benefit across skin types.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the product helped calm redness a little; no other redness-specific reports appear.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers do not describe barrier repair specifically, though several sensitive-skin users note the product does not irritate or compromise their skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the toner helped reduce dark spots; this is not corroborated elsewhere in the set.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, but one reviewer describes new facial breakouts after starting use (resolved by moving application to the neck) and another mentions ongoing breakouts she couldn't attribute definitively to the product.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers with combination or normal-to-oily concerns report no excess oil or greasy feel after use; the serum is generally described as non-greasy and non-sticky.

extraits.titre: Hydrating for my sensitive dry skin
extraits.texte: I use toner pads daily, and have tried many different brands, both Korean and non-Korean. I've been using this product for about a week and it does hydrate and give me a nice glow, prepping my skin for the rest of my routine. I can't tell yet if it has any firming or lifting effects though. I always appreciate that COSRx is fragrance free and works well for my sensitive and mature dry skin. I'm looking forward to finishing the entire jar of pads to see but from what I've experienced so far, I would consider purchasing this product.

I like the look and feel of the cotton pad and the texture of the serum itself. The pad was a very good size, so I used it on my face and my neck. The ingredients seem fine but my only concern was that my face started breaking out after I began using this item. I switched to only using it on my neck from now on and will continue to use it. I like the way my skin feels after I use the product.

extraits.titre: Bouncy skin and instant hydration boost!
extraits.texte: This has helped keep my combination evenly and visibly hydrated. The shape of the pads work great as a mask for my undereyes and smile lines and after a couple weeks I've noticed that wrinkles have been reduced and my genetic hollow undereyes looked a bit more lifted and full. My skin does look glowy after a single use with no sticky residue. The product itself has a generous amount of pretty pink serum, every pad is soaked through! The serum is slightly watery, as a toner it is great. The product is very convenient as both toner pads and a mini mask. The pads are lightly larger than a cotton round. The tub is a pretty big size, I keep it on a shelf in my bathroom. It does take up a good amount of space, but the label and pink color of the tub are aesthetically pleasing to the eye. The ingredients make a good combination in a single product. The collagen and B-12 (makes it pink!) are great for calming any redness and puffiness as skin prep in the am. The niancinamide and adenosine has helped even my skintone and rid me of those little bumps over time. With hyaluronic acid and peptides my skin hydration has been more consistent on a day to day basis. Overall, I'm very happy with this product and want to try the other toner pads, but this one has worked so well it'll be hard to switch!

I have been using this product AM and PM as my first step after cleansing for about a week. I have noticed increased firmness and plumpness already. The ingredient list is amazing and perfect for mature skin with copper peptides, collagen, adenosine, hyaluronic acid, and more. The liquid in the pads is watery enough to use before other toners, essences, or serums, so I feel like it really has a chance to soak in and work its magic. The pads are nice and juicy, and it seems like there is plenty of liquid to last the whole jar. The texture of the pads is very thin and cottony; they feel spongy and luxurious and don't fall apart or pill. The tweezers are a nice touch, but I usually just grab a pad with my fingers tbh. There is no added fragrance, which I love. The pads have a chubby crescent moon shape that makes it easy to use them as eye patches or as a mask. This is a nice touch that I have not seen with other pads. The pink packaging is actually gorgeous and looks nice on my vanity.I am enjoying the pads very much, and I hope COSRX will offer even more products with this same formula. I would especially love a toner or a toner mist (hint hint!)

extraits.titre: If you have mature skin- meet your new best friend!
extraits.texte: I was really excited to try this new One Step Original Peptide Collagen Lifting Glow Pad! The packaging is absolutely on point. The container is easy to open and comes with tweezers to gently pick up singular pads. It has very little smell. The pads are soft and packed with goodness. I love how easy it is to use. After I swipe my face, there is still plenty of serum left on the pad. I tear it in half and place one piece on either side of my chin, where I have some fine lines when I laugh. They stay pretty well and I remove them after about 10 minutes. The serum soaks into your face pretty quickly and my skin feels very hydrated and glowy. Not sticky at all, which is nice.I have had some issues with breakouts since I started using the pads. I have very sensitive skin, so I haven't narrowed down what the issue might be. I really hate the idea of not using them daily, so I'm hoping it will clear up shortly. I absolutely recommend trying these, especially if you have mature skin. I noticed a difference in some of my fine lines after a week of consistent use. Not like getting botox or a face-lift, of course, but a noticeable difference to me.

I bought these to use on my jaw line and my turkey neck. I cant tell if its helping, its to soon. But I have very sensitive skin and it caused no irritation. I would of liked it better if it werent so tacky. I wanted to use it at night but it never seems to dry. Also I have arthritis in my hands and its hard for me to get them apart. So even though I had no issues I would rather use a serum that drys more and wont reorder them.

I've been using it everyday and it has a made a difference on my skin for sure! Especially in areas that are really dry! I do deal with combination skin and acne around my chin in case you're wondering!
